description: Trigger accuracy evals for tune-monitor (AI-1687): monitor-noise and which-monitors-to-tune requests trigger it, including with no monitor named; incidents, monitor creation and coverage do not.

cases.rationale: Explicit tune request with a monitor UUID

cases.prompt: Which of my monitors should I tune?
cases.rationale: No monitor named: starts from the account-wide suggestion list

cases.prompt: My monitors keep firing alerts that turn out to be nothing. Can we cut the noise?
cases.rationale: Monitor noise without a named monitor

cases.prompt: This freshness monitor on orders alerts every morning and it's always fine. Make it less sensitive.
cases.rationale: Sensitivity change on a noisy monitor

cases.prompt: Are there any tuning suggestions waiting for me in Monte Carlo?
cases.rationale: Asks for the tuning agent's stored suggestions

cases.prompt: My orders table is stale, figure out why.
cases.rationale: Incident root cause, not monitor noise (incident-response)

cases.prompt: Create a volume monitor on the payments table.
What should I monitor in my warehouse?
How do I fix the alert on dim_customers from this morning?
cases.rationale: Fixing an alert is remediation; it reaches tuning only when the plan says the monitor is noise
